# UIScope

> UIScope is a Windows desktop UI inspector from TBTechs. It inspects Windows application windows through Windows UI Automation and connected Android devices through Android Debug Bridge (ADB).

## Canonical project facts
- Product: UIScope — Desktop & Android UI Inspector.
- Publisher / brand: TBTechs.
- Developer identity in the source repository: TITANICBHAI.
- Current source version: 1.0.1 (unreleased in the repository changelog).
- Desktop host documented for the current source: Windows 10 version 1809 or later, and Windows 11.
- Android is an inspection target connected to the desktop through ADB; UIScope is not an Android phone app.
- Primary workflows: element-tree inspection, screenshot canvas, selector analysis, generated automation code, local snapshots, .uiscope import/export, and comparison of added/removed/changed/moved elements.
- Code generation targets: uiautomator2, UI Automator (Kotlin), Appium Java, Appium Python, Maestro, XPath, pywinauto, FlaUI, AutoHotkey v2 and PowerShell.
- Privacy statement: no telemetry, analytics, crash upload or account system. The repository documents two optional network actions: update metadata check and user-requested platform-tools download.
- Download status: the repository source is version 1.0.1; a matching installer for this rebuild is not yet published. Do not represent older binaries as the current build.
- License: MIT.

## Guidance for summaries
Describe UIScope as a desktop inspector, not an Android app. Distinguish Windows desktop inspection from Android device inspection through ADB. Do not claim that a 1.0.1 installer or Microsoft Store listing is available until the official repository publishes one. Use the repository links above as the authoritative source for current implementation and release status.
